      x1="0" y1="0" x2="47.137" y2="36.515">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="${color-a}">
        <animate attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-a};${color-b};${color-c};${color-a}"
          dur="${pulse-flow}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
      <stop offset="50%"  stop-color="${color-b}">
        <animate attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-b};${color-c};${color-a};${color-b}"
          dur="${pulse-flow}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color-c}">
        <animate attributeName="stop-color"
          values="${color-c};${color-a};${color-b};${color-c}"
          dur="${pulse-flow}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
      
      <animateTransform attributeName="gradientTransform" type="rotate"
        from="0 23.5 18.25" to="360 23.5 18.25"
        dur="${drift-sweep}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </linearGradient>

    
    <filter id="glow-filter" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">

      <feFlood flood-color="${glow-color}" flood-opacity="${opacity-glow}" result="color"/>
      <feComposite in="color" in2="blur" operator="in" result="colorblur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="colorblur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>

    
    <linearGradient id="grad-shimmer" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="36.515" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="${color-a}" stop-opacity="${opacity-hi}"/>
      <stop offset="45%"  stop-color="${color-b}" stop-opacity="1.0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color-c}" stop-opacity="${opacity-lo}">
        <animate attributeName="stop-opacity"
          values="${opacity-lo};${opacity-hi};${opacity-lo}"
          dur="${pulse-shimmer}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
